scenario: 社区搜索（UGC短文本）：关注语义匹配、查询理解、召回、相关性排序及LLM应用。

papers.title: UIBK-Embedding: Effective Text Retrieval by Unifying Dense and Late-Interaction Retrieval
papers.authors: Abdelrahman Abdallah, Mohammed Ali, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.27195v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Dense bi-encoders and late-interaction retrievers are usually treated as alternatives, yet they fail on different queries: one vector captures what a text is about, token-level matching finds its exact entities and phrases. Using both today means two models, two indexes and a score-fusion step. We present UIBK-Embedding-v1, a 179M-parameter English encoder that produces both representations in one pass and scores them with one unmodified MaxSim. The dense embedding is written into the list of token vectors as three extra vectors, and a one-dimensional tag keeps the two kinds of vectors from matching each other, so that plain MaxSim equals the token-level MaxSim plus a weighted dense cosine. The model therefore runs in a standard late-interaction index without changes; we test it with PLAID. A shared 18-layer trunk with a separate 4-layer top per head, and a cross-encoder distilled into the fused score, turn the two heads into one retriev
papers.summary: 全局语义和词级匹配各有所长，作者把两者放进一次编码。模型用额外向量保存全局信息，并用标签隔离两类匹配，能直接接入现有多向量索引。BEIR 上的 nDCG@10 达到 59.79。
papers.key_insight: 融合两种检索信号不一定要维护两套模型和索引。把全局分数写进标准的词级匹配计算，可以保留现成索引的服务路径，也让蒸馏直接优化最终融合分数。

papers.title: FLINT: Fixed-budget Late Interaction
papers.authors: Himank Handa, Negar Arabzadeh, Matei Zaharia
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.27273v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-vector retrieval models such as ColBERT often outperform single-vector models of comparable scale by matching queries and documents at the token level. However, retaining a vector for every token substantially increases storage requirements and slows retrieval compared to single-vector bi-encoders, limiting their scalability. We introduce FLINT (Fixed-budget Late INTeraction), an architecture that uses attention-based pooling to represent each query and document with a fixed number of embedding vectors. Unlike architectures that pool only document representations while retaining token-level queries, FLINT applies pooling symmetrically to both sides, limiting document storage and the number of vector comparisons needed during retrieval. FLINT achieves comparable ranking effectiveness to the closest baselines on BEIR and outperforms them on several benchmarks with longer and more complex queries, including BrowseComp+, CRUMB, and TRE
papers.summary: 逐词保存向量能改善检索，却让索引和匹配开销随文本变长。作者用注意力聚合，把查询和文档都压成固定数量的向量，保留多向量匹配。长查询语料上的端到端检索比最近的对照模型快 1.5—2.8 倍。
papers.key_insight: 向量预算可以同时约束查询侧和文档侧。只压缩文档能省存储，但长查询仍会触发大量比较；两侧一起聚合，才把索引体积和在线匹配计算纳入同一个预算。

papers.title: GARRET: Generative Feedback for Region Retrieval in Visual Documents
papers.authors: Weijian Jian, Siyang Chen, Yuguang Yang, Yajun Zhang, Chunyu Xie, Dawei Leng, Yuhui Yin
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.27829v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation over visually rich documents requires evidence at a finer granularity than entire pages. Existing visual retrievers typically index or return full pages, whereas training region-level retrievers often requires costly query-to-region annotations or noisy model-generated labels. We introduce GARRET, a region-retrieval framework trained from (page, question, answer) triplets through differentiable generative feedback. A shared context-preserving retriever produces page and region multi-vector representations. During training, their retrieval scores define a soft routing distribution over candidate region crops. An auxiliary vision-language model attends to each crop separately, aggregates crop-specific contexts using the routing weights, and predicts the question followed by the answer under a next-token prediction objective. Gradients through the routing distribution assign query-conditioned cred
papers.summary: 整页检索常找得到文档，却定位不到真正回答问题的图表区域。作者让生成模型的训练反馈分配到候选区域，检索器由此学习细粒度匹配，推理时移除生成模块。区域检索的宏平均 nDCG@10 达到 0.4126。
papers.key_insight: 答案生成的误差可以反过来教检索器看哪个区域，而不必逐块人工标注。辅助生成器只参与训练，这让细粒度监督的收益留在检索器中，线上仍保持单独检索的路径。

papers.title: SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.26425v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that cura
papers.summary: 标签很少时，医疗实体也能靠术语知识和候选重排完成匹配。系统先找实体片段，再召回概念，用多个编码器联合重排；领域文本与术语层级补足训练信息。宏平均字符交并比达到 0.5387。
papers.key_insight: 概念别名和层级关系可以承担部分监督，尤其能帮助训练中从未出现的实体。对社区中的冷门品牌、地点或专业词，值得借鉴的是知识组织与召回重排的配合，而非照搬医疗标签体系。

papers.title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs
papers.authors: Adri\'an S\'anchez-Freire, Gonzalo P\'erez-G\'omez, Aitziber Atutxa, Ander Barrena
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.26339v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved thr
papers.summary: 小语料上选出的检索方案，扩大到真实规模后可能失效。作者固定相关证据，逐步扩大语料，并比较摘要、平铺全文和层次全文的效果与成本。层次表示所需的索引单元减少 67%。
papers.key_insight: 语料规模本身也是评测变量。相关文档没有消失，新增干扰文档仍会改变召回与重排的收益；把规模、证据格式和成本一起评估，比只在一个小集合上比较最终问答分数更有解释力。

papers.title: Bring multimodal semantic search to the edge with EmbeddingGemma 2
papers.authors: Google AI Edge Team, Android ML Team
papers.abstract: 740M parameter multimodal embedding model. Unified text/image/video/audio space, modular encoders, approximately 191 MB active RAM for text weights and 567 MB full model on Pixel 11 Pro. MediaPipe UniversalEmbedder, SemanticRetriever and SQLite implement local search-as-you-type and visual keyframe retrieval.
papers.summary: 本地图片与视频搜索无需先把每种媒体转成文字。谷歌把文本、图像和音频映射到共同向量空间，配合本地数据库完成边输入边检索。官方报告，纯文本权重的活动内存约为 191MB。
papers.key_insight: 跨模态统一表示能省掉中间的描述生成与转写链路。对于设备内搜索，分开加载所需模态比始终启用完整模型更省内存；内存数字对应官方给定设备与配置，不能当作服务器延迟指标。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Step Query Rewriting via Corpus Feedback for Conversational Search
papers.authors: João Coelho, Hong Wang, Jie Yuan, Zhuoer Wang, Samson Koelle, Wei Niu
papers.abstract: Sequential conversational retrieval with three typed rewrite operations and a stop action. SFT then reinforcement learning from retrieval-quality reward without human rewrite annotations. Evaluated on TopiOCQA, QReCC and CAsT. No quantitative effect size in abstract.
papers.summary: 对话查询缺少上下文时，一次改写未必能找到正确表达。作者让模型交替改写与检索，读取语料反馈后决定继续还是停止，并用检索排名训练策略。TopiOCQA 上的 nDCG@3 达到 40.6。
papers.key_insight: 改写所需的词汇可以从刚召回的内容中学习。原文消融显示，动作分类本身并不带来收益，关键是根据语料反馈安排连续动作；这一收益也伴随着额外搜索轮次。

papers.title: Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents
papers.authors: Yutong Leng, Haojiong Chen, Fukai Shang, Xiaoyang Wang, Mindong Liu, Runyuan Ma, Jiantao Qiu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.21424v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification. We instantiate SPRA across more than one million AI papers, with 19.95 million research units and 24.07 million internal relations. Evaluations access SPRA through Schema-RAG with task evidence fixed before inference. Across seven subfields, SPRA improves source-conditioned scientific QA by 0.381/5 over passage retrieval while remaining close to Full Compact (0.078/5 lower on average).
papers.summary: 论文里的问题、方法和结果分散在叙述中，检索后仍难组合。作者把它们整理成带类型关系的研究对象，并保留出处供核查。在七个子领域，科学问答评分比段落检索高 0.381 分，满分为 5 分。
papers.key_insight: 索引单位可以是能复用的研究对象，而非固定长度的段落。问题、实验设置和结论各自有身份与出处，跨论文比较就能沿着关系取证；代价是构建与维护结构化表示。

papers.title: Accuracy you can check.
papers.abstract: First-party vendor evaluations of conare-embed-1 and conare-rerank-1: ViDoRe v3 embedding nDCG@10 67.0 on 19,252 pages and 2,419 English/French questions. Reranking nDCG@10 70.2 with identical 150-page candidates. LMEB 75.0 over 13 commercially permitted tasks. Provider-run benchmark, not independent production verification.
papers.summary: 检索模型不能只看一张总榜，评测还要交代候选集合和任务。厂商公开了文档嵌入、重排及多条件匹配结果，并在重排时固定首阶段候选。其自测的文档重排 nDCG@10 为 70.2，尚无独立复现。
papers.key_insight: 固定候选集合能把重排器的贡献与首阶段召回分开。多条件近似文档也能暴露向量相似度掩盖的约束错误；这些数据来自厂商，适合生成复测清单，不能替代自有查询集的测量。

papers.title: Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.22218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: As LLM agents are exposed to hundreds to tens of thousands of skills, tools, and API functions, full-library prompting becomes costly, slow, and less reliable: each added candidate increases prompt tokens and latency, while longer candidate lists introduce more distractors for LLM selection. We present Toollery, a training-free candidate-compression framework for scalable LLM skill/tool selection. Following established document-side query expansion, Toollery generates user-intent queries from each skill/tool specification and builds a retrieval index that maps real user requests to compact candidate sets before final LLM decision-making. By treating high-level skills and atomic tools as selectable capabilities, Toollery can be applied to both skill libraries and tool registries. We evaluate Toollery on the roughly 79K-capability SkillRouter benchmark, BFCL-V4 with over 440 atomic tools, and 3,396 proprietary smart-cockpit reque
papers.summary: 工具库很大时，把全部说明交给语言模型既慢又容易选错。作者从工具说明离线生成用户可能提出的请求，建成检索索引，线上只把少量候选交给模型。评测覆盖约 7.9 万项能力的工具选择基准。
papers.key_insight: 可以在文档侧补齐用户说法，而不在每次请求时扩写查询。工具库能借此把模型要读的候选数固定下来；效果仍取决于生成请求能否覆盖真实需求，论文未在摘要给出统一收益幅度。
